newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba says sees slower earnings growth in 97.
newsitem.headline: Veba says sees slower earnings growth in 97.

text.p: German diversified utility group Veba AG said on Wednesday that it did not expect 1997 earnings growth to match that of recent years.
"Veba expects further earnings growth in the current financial year, albeit without the high growth rates achieved in recent years," the group said in a statement.
Veba said that sustained measures for enhancing productivity, portfolio optimisation and the expansion and internationalisation of its core business would help boost earnings.
Veba warned, however, the extent of earnings growth would be considerably influenced by general economic conditions.
